trace.title: Metric contract
trace.detail: Prometheus commonly scrapes exposed metrics and stores time series. Grafana can query/display data from selected sources. A dashboard is a view over a data contract, not an independent guarantee that the service is healthy.

trace.title: Follow one item
trace.detail:
App records bounded metric → collector observes → query transforms over a time window → panel/alert presents it → investigator checks user outcome. A missing scrape and a true zero value are different things.

For a latency claim, ask which requests were included and whether errors/timeouts were excluded. A low median can coexist with painful tail latency.

trace.title: Try the failure
trace.detail: A mean alone can hide a slow minority. Unbounded labels can overwhelm the system. A pretty dashboard with no action/owner can fail silently during an incident.
